assumptions: In-tree `vmaf` crate (pure-Rust libvmaf v3.2.1 match) via metrics/vmaf.rs score() with model V061 / Ingress::Studio601 (mod.rs:~2324) — same v0 features as `vmaf`, different ingress.
Single still frame: motion2=0 (validation scan only, lib.rs:1037-1078).
SVM support-vector count is model data, not source; per-SV cost documented, counted at 1.
VIF uses u16/u32 integer pipeline (FILTERS=[17,9,5,3] at vif.rs:17-24) with log2 LUT finalize; per-elem tap counts are exact from FILTERS, interior bookkeeping is a stage estimate.
ADM is 4-scale 4-tap DWT2 (adm.rs:139-217 indices, 353-547 kernels) + decouple/csf/cm per scale; per-elem op splits are stage estimates from kernel loop structure.
Written before reading swe's vmaf/vmaf-neg tallies (read-after-write rule).

stages.name: RGB8 -> YUV420 u8 planes (601)
stages.notes: Studio601 path: lum=16+(65.481R+128.553G+24.966B)/255 round clamp; chroma u_sum/v_sum accumulate (3 mul + 2 add)/px each, (u/4,v/4)+128 round clamp(16,240) per 2x2. Stage estimate over fused per-2x2-block loop.

stages.name: VIF scale0 stats (F=17) + finalize
stages.notes: 5acc x 17taps x(mul+add) vertical + horizontal + finalize (mean-sq, sigmas, gain div, 2-3 log2 LUT gathers). stage estimate. (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: VIF subsample s0->s1
stages.notes: 2accs x F1=9 taps v+h per out px (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: VIF subsample s1->s2
stages.notes: F2=5 (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: VIF subsample s2->s3
stages.notes: F3=3 (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: ADM DWT2 scale0 x2img
stages.notes: 4-tap lo/hi vertical (2x(4mul+3add+shift) per col) + horizontal 4 outputs x(4mul+3add); stage estimate (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: ADM DWT2 scales1-3 combined x2img
stages.notes: i32 a-band -> h/v/d bands + next a; same 4-tap structure (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: ADM decouple r/a x4scales x3bands
stages.notes: per band-px: ot_dp/o_mag/t_mag i64 dots, angle flag, div LUT + gain, r/a writes; stage estimate (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: ADM csf_i16 x3bands x4scales
stages.notes: rfactor mul+shift per band -> dst + flt (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: ADM cm_i16 + den_scale x4scales
stages.notes: 3-row window sums + xsq/xcub shifted accum + den estimate; stage estimate (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: motion2 single-frame (zero)
stages.notes: single frame: validation scan only; SAD loop never runs, motion2=0 (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: v0 SVM predict + clip
stages.notes: 6-feature RBF SVM: slopes*raw+intercepts (12), then NSV x (6 sub+mul+add + mul+exp+add) — NSV is model data, counted at 1 SV; slope/clip tail
